questions.stem: Why can smoking during pregnancy harm the developing fetus?

options.text: Nicotine causes the fetus to grow too quickly
Carbon monoxide reduces the amount of oxygen reaching the fetus
Smoke particles pass directly into the amniotic fluid
Smoking increases the amount of nutrients reaching the fetus

questions.explanation: Carbon monoxide from cigarette smoke binds to haemoglobin in the mother's blood, reducing the amount of oxygen that can be carried to the fetus via the placenta. This can lead to low birth weight.
